plan.name: discount-whisperer-v3

meta.goal: Ship a working, deployed Discount Whisperer in 4 hours. A merchant's offers live in Supabase. Every edit rebuilds a small "ladder" file in Cloudflare KV. A widget on a demo product page shows offers that apply now, the cheapest next unlock, and a product that fills the gap. Pay creates a real Razorpay test-mode order, and the server re-validates the offer with the same rules code before charging.
meta.cost_budget: INR 0. Free tiers and test mode only.

env_vars.var: Server only. Never in the widget or demo page.
Postgres connection string with password, for applying migrations.
Random 32+ characters. Shared by the Supabase trigger and the Worker.

preflight.note: Secrets are exported only in the shell of the task that needs them. Never paste them into prompts, files or reports.

product.one_line: An offers widget that shows what applies now and what a shopper unlocks by adding a little more, for shoppers at small Indian D2C stores and the merchants who pay for those offers.
product.north_star: AOV uplift for sessions that saw the widget.
product.input_metrics: widget_seen_rate = seen / page views (null: no page_view event); nudge_click_rate = nudge_click / seen; addon_rate = addon / nudge_click; paid_rate = payment_verified / checkout.
product.guardrails: Shown-versus-validated mismatch = 0. Validated-versus-charged mismatch = 0. Discount spend within each offer's cap.
product.in_scope_offer_types: pct (percent off, optional cap); flat (fixed amount off); cashback_pct (percent cashback, optional cap; shown as savings, NOT deducted from the charged amount). Each may require a payment method (UPI, HDFC_CC, ...) and has min order, start time and end time.
product.out_of_scope: No-cost EMI. Per-shopper eligibility, usage caps, personal offers. SKU-level offers. Merchant dashboard UI. Razorpay live mode, refunds, settlements. CDN purge-by-URL.

design.big_idea: Offers only change at a few cart values. On every edit, precompute each merchant's offers into a small sorted "ladder" file. Each page view binary-searches its step in the browser. The server is touched only on edits and at payment.

components.component: Source of truth. Tables offers, fillers, outbox, events, payments, app_config. RPC functions write an offer and its outbox row in one transaction. RLS on, no anon policies: only the Worker (service role) reads and writes.
AFTER INSERT on outbox: net.http_post to the Worker's /internal/rebuild with header x-rebuild-secret. Worker URL and secret read from app_config, so they can be set after deploy.
Admin routes, ladder route, internal rebuild, checkout validate, Razorpay order and verify, events, metrics, and a cron reconciler every 5 min as the safety net.
Key ladder:{merchantId}. Eventually consistent; checkout always re-reads Supabase.
buildLadder, lookup, bruteForce, savingPaise, validateSelection. Used by the Worker and bundled into the widget.
Fetches the ladder, runs lookup locally, renders, sends events. 800 ms timeout, fails closed.
Static page served by Worker static assets. Cart controls, payment-method picker, Razorpay Checkout (checkout.js) in test mode.
Orders API with offers[], Standard Checkout, HMAC signature verification on the server.

data_model.rule: All money is integer paise. Never floats for money. Rs 1,999 = 199900.
All times are epoch milliseconds (UTC) in TypeScript, timestamptz in Postgres.
data_model.table: id text pk (e.g. "m1_O1"), merchant_id text, code text ("O1"), kind text check in (pct, flat, cashback_pct), value int, max_paise int null, min_order_paise int default 0, method text null, starts_at timestamptz, ends_at timestamptz, funded_by text check in (merchant, bank), razorpay_offer_id text null, active bool default true, updated_at timestamptz default now(). Index (merchant_id, active).
merchant_id text, sku text, name text, price_paise int, pk (merchant_id, sku). Max 20 per merchant (enforced in API).
id bigserial pk, merchant_id text, created_at timestamptz default now(), processed_at timestamptz null. Partial index where processed_at is null.

id bigserial pk, merchant_id text, session_id text, type text check in (seen, nudge_click, addon, checkout, payment_verified), cart_paise int, offer_id text null, created_at timestamptz default now(). Index (merchant_id, type).

id bigserial pk, merchant_id text, offer_id text null, razorpay_order_id text unique, razorpay_payment_id text unique null, amount_paise int, cart_paise int (checkpoint-1 addition), expected_saving_paise int, mode text check in (razorpay_offer, server_discount) (checkpoint-1 addition), status text check in (created, verified, failed), created_at, updated_at.
key text pk, value text. Keys: rebuild_url, rebuild_secret. Readable only by the trigger function (security definer).
data_model.rpc: One transaction: upsert the offer row, insert an outbox row for its merchant.

rpc.name: set_fillers_with_outbox(p_merchant_id text, p_fillers jsonb) returns int

data_model.rpc: One transaction: replace fillers, insert outbox row.
data_model.ladder: See packages/contracts/src/types/ladder.ts (fields, sort order, version hash). razorpayOfferId is NOT in the ladder.

lookup_semantics.authoritative: packages/contracts/src/types/lookup.ts and validate.ts doc comments, plus fixtures/golden.json (32 cases, independently recomputed).
lookup_semantics.step: Live offer: active and startsAt <= now < endsAt.
step = number of live offers with minOrderPaise <= cartPaise (method does not matter).
Offers with min <= cart: method null or equal -> applicable; offer needs a method and input method is null -> conditional; else drop. Both sorted by savingPaise desc, then offerId asc.

Offers with min > cart: keep if offer method null, equal, or input method null. gapPaise = min - cart. savingPaise at exactly min. score = saving / gap. Sort score desc, gap asc, merchant-funded first, id asc. Top 3. Each carries method.
Filler: cheapest (then sku asc) with pricePaise >= unlockable[0].gapPaise. Null if none fits or nothing to unlock.
savingPaise: pct and cashback_pct = floor(cart * value / 100), capped at maxPaise if set. flat = min(value, cart).
lookup_semantics.validate_selection: validateSelection(offers, {cartPaise, method, offerId|null, nowMs}) -> {valid, reason, savingPaise, chargePaise}. offerId null -> valid, saving 0. Check order: unknown_offer, inactive, not_started, expired, below_min, method_mismatch. Invalid: saving 0, charge = cart. chargePaise = cart - saving for pct and flat; = cart for cashback_pct. Charge may be 0; payments must reject below 100 paise (409 amount_too_low).
lookup_semantics.invariant: lookup(buildLadder(offers, nowB), x) deep-equals bruteForce(offers, x) for every x with x.nowMs >= nowB. Every offer in lookup().applicable passes validateSelection with the same saving.

api_contract.mounting: apps/api/src/index.ts (frozen) mounts each module at a prefix; module paths are relative. Modules export xRoutes(deps: Deps): Hono<AppEnv>. createApp(deps) is exported for tests.
api_contract.endpoint: 200 ladder JSON. Cache-Control: public, max-age=60. ETag = version; If-None-Match returns 304. 404 {error:"unknown_merchant"}. CORS: GET from any origin.
Body NewOffer. rpc upsert_offer_with_outbox. 201 {offer}. 400 validation errors. 401 bad token.
Partial offer; merge then re-validate with NewOfferSchema. 200 {offer}.
Body {merchant_id}. Rebuilds and marks outbox rows processed (Repo rebuild protocol). 200 {version}. Constant-time compare.
Body {merchantId, cartPaise, method, offerId}. Re-reads offers from Supabase (never KV). 200 ValidateResult.

Body {merchantId, cartPaise, method, offerId|null}. validateSelection; invalid -> 409 {error:"invalid_offer", detail: reason}; amount below 100 paise -> 409 amount_too_low. Valid: Razorpay test order, payments row status created. 200 {keyId, orderId, amountPaise, currency:"INR", expectedSavingPaise, mode}.

Body {razorpay_order_id, razorpay_payment_id, razorpay_signature}. HMAC-SHA256(order_id + "|" + payment_id, key_secret), constant-time compare. Marks verified or failed. Idempotent on payment_id. 200 {verified}.
Body EventRequest. 202. Max body 1 KB. Sent as text/plain via sendBeacon: parse JSON regardless of Content-Type. CORS any origin.
api_contract.errors: All errors: {error: snake_case_code, detail?}. Never stack traces or upstream secrets.
api_contract.logging: One JSON line per request: {ts, route, merchantId, status, ms, ladderVersion?, razorpayOrderId?}. Never log keys, signatures or card data.

razorpay_contract.order_create: POST https://api.razorpay.com/v1/orders, Basic auth (key_id:key_secret). Body {amount, currency:"INR", receipt (max 40 chars, "dw_{merchantId}_{ms}"), notes {merchantId, offerId}}.
razorpay_contract.mode: Offer has razorpay_offer_id: amount = cartPaise, offers = [razorpay_offer_id]. Razorpay applies the discount at Checkout.
No razorpay_offer_id: amount = chargePaise, no offers array. Record mode in payments.
razorpay_contract.checkout: Demo loads https://checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js and opens Razorpay({key: keyId, order_id, amount, currency, name, handler}). Handler posts the three razorpay_* fields to /v1/payments/verify.
razorpay_contract.verify: expected = HMAC_SHA256_hex(key_secret, order_id + "|" + payment_id). Constant-time compare. crypto.subtle in the Worker.
razorpay_contract.test_payments: Use Razorpay's documented test cards and UPI ids. Never hardcode card numbers; link the docs.

widget_contract.cart_updates: Listens on window for CustomEvent "dw:cart" {cartPaise, method?}. Removes the listener in disconnectedCallback.
widget_contract.loading: Fetch only when visible (IntersectionObserver), once per page. 800 ms AbortController timeout. On any error: render nothing, one console.debug line.
widget_contract.render: Applies now; conditional ("if you pay with UPI"); top unlock with the gap in rupees; gap-filler line with an "Add" button that dispatches CustomEvent "dw:add" {sku, pricePaise}. Shadow DOM.
widget_contract.events: seen (once, when rendered with data), nudge_click, addon. navigator.sendBeacon (text/plain), fallback fetch keepalive.
widget_contract.budget: At most 15 KB gzip. Imports offer-core; never zod or supabase-js.

demo_contract.test_ids: cart-value, qty-plus, qty-minus, pay-method, pay-button, order-result, verify-result
demo_contract.behaviour: api-base from ?api= (default same origin; ?api=mock uses public/mock-ladder.json). Product: Rs 1,800 tant saree (180000 paise). Method select: Any, UPI, HDFC_CC. Pay calls /v1/payments/order with the best applicable offer for the chosen method, opens Razorpay Checkout, then /v1/payments/verify, shows the result.

stack.runtime: Node LTS, pnpm 11 workspaces, TypeScript 5.9 strict, ESM only. pnpm 11 blocks dependency build scripts: add packages that need them under allowBuilds in pnpm-workspace.yaml via a REPORT.md request (root file, T0/T7 owned) or note it.
stack.dependencies: hono (T2,T4); zod (T2,T4,T6; never in widget); @supabase/supabase-js (T2,T4); wrangler (T2,T4,T7); @cloudflare/workers-types; @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers (T2,T4); vitest (T1,T2,T4,T5); fast-check (T1); preact, vite, happy-dom (T5); supabase CLI optional (T3); @faker-js/faker (T6); playwright (T6,T7); k6 binary (T6,T7).
stack.cloudflare: Workers free: 100k requests/day, 10 ms CPU per request. KV: check free read/write limits. Cron */5. Static assets serve apps/demo/public (T7).
stack.supabase: Free projects pause when idle. pg_net is async; trigger never blocks the write. Mumbai region.
stack.datasets: Synthetic offers (T6): 50 merchants m1..m50, 3 to 8 offers each, seeded RNG; m1 is the golden merchant exactly; m50 has 250 offers.
stack.golden_merchant: Exactly sets.m1 in packages/contracts/fixtures/golden.json (O1 pct 10 cap 30000 min 199900; O2 flat 25000 min 249900 HDFC_CC bank; O3 cashback_pct 5 min 0 UPI; fillers gamcha 19900, handloom stole 44900, silk potli bag 69900, tant saree 129900; window 2026-01-01 to 2030-01-01).

task.name: offer-core
task.context: packages/contracts defines types, signatures and golden.json. This package is the single rules brain for the Worker and the widget. A bug here shows or charges the wrong money.
task.objective: Implement buildLadder, lookup, bruteForce, savingPaise and validateSelection exactly per lookup_semantics and the contract doc comments, proven by golden tests and property tests.

scope.in: packages/offer-core/** (src/money.ts, brute.ts, build.ts, lookup.ts, validate.ts, hash.ts, index.ts, test/**, bench/**, package.json, tsconfig.json, vitest.config.ts)

task.constraints: Package name @dw/offer-core. No runtime dependencies. "import type" only from @dw/contracts (golden.json may be imported in tests). No Date.now() inside; time is passed in. Runs in browsers and Workers. Version hash: synchronous FNV-1a 64-bit (BigInt or two 32-bit halves) over canonical JSON with sorted keys of {v, merchantId, disabled, offers, fillers}, 16 lower-case hex chars; document it. Integer paise; Math.floor for percentages. Signatures: buildLadder(input: BuildLadderInput): Ladder; lookup(ladder: Ladder, input: LookupInput): LookupResult; bruteForce(offers: readonly Offer[], fillers: readonly Filler[], input: LookupInput): LookupResult; savingPaise(offer, cartPaise): number; validateSelection(offers: readonly Offer[], input: ValidateInput): ValidateResult.
task.subagents: Haiku: table-driven golden test file from golden.json. Sonnet: fast-check property tests: (a) lookup equals bruteForce, 10,000 runs; (b) every applicable offer passes validateSelection with the same saving; (c) savings never exceed cart or cap; (d) buildLadder deterministic; (e) ladder offers sorted.
task.loop: money.ts and brute.ts first (the reference) > build.ts > lookup.ts > validate.ts > golden tests > property tests > fix. Max 5 iterations. Stop when all tests pass twice in a row with two different seeds.
task.acceptance: pnpm --filter @dw/offer-core test: all golden cases pass. Property tests: 0 counterexamples on two seeds. Typecheck passes. Bench: lookup on a 250-offer ladder under 50 microseconds median in Node. grep finds no zod import in src.

task.name: supabase-db
task.context: Hosted Supabase project from pre-flight. The Worker talks to it only with the service-role key, through tables and RPC functions named in packages/contracts/src/db.ts.
task.objective: Migrations for all tables, RPC functions, RLS, the pg_net outbox trigger reading app_config, and the golden-merchant seed, applied to the hosted project and verified by a smoke script.

scope.in: supabase/migrations/0001_tables.sql, 0002_rpc.sql, 0003_rls.sql, 0004_outbox_trigger.sql, supabase/seed.sql (m1 only, razorpay_offer_id NULL), supabase/tests/smoke.mjs, supabase/README.md
scope.out: apps/**, packages/**, tools/**. Do not insert real app_config values (T7 does).

task.constraints: Columns exactly per packages/contracts/src/db.ts (including payments.cart_paise and payments.mode). Every table: RLS enabled, no policies. RPC functions: SECURITY INVOKER, explicit search_path, single transaction each; upsert_offer_with_outbox validates kind, value range (percent 1..100), flat has null max_paise, ends_at > starts_at, paise non-negative; raises on bad input. p_offer keys are snake_case column names. Repo needs: pendingOutboxMaxId and markOutboxProcessed(merchant, upToId) work with plain table queries; no extra RPC required. Trigger: AFTER INSERT ON outbox FOR EACH ROW; reads rebuild_url and rebuild_secret from app_config; if either missing, do nothing; net.http_post with header x-rebuild-secret and body {"merchant_id": ...}. Trigger function SECURITY DEFINER, fixed search_path, owned by postgres. Idempotent migrations where practical. Apply with supabase db push or psql "$SUPABASE_DB_URL" -f each file in order.
task.env: SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, SUPABASE_DB_URL. Never write them to files. If they are not exported in your shell, write and locally lint the SQL, then stop and ask the human to export them before applying.
task.subagents: Haiku: 0001_tables.sql and seed.sql. Sonnet: smoke.mjs with supabase-js and the service role: call each RPC, check an outbox row appears, metrics_for_merchant returns counts, clean up test rows.
task.loop: tables > rpc > rls > trigger > apply > smoke > fix. Max 4 iterations. Stop when smoke passes.
task.acceptance: All 4 migrations apply cleanly to the hosted project. node supabase/tests/smoke.mjs exits 0. As the anon key, select from offers returns no rows or a permission error. Inserting an outbox row with app_config empty succeeds.

task.name: razorpay-payments
task.context: index.ts mounts routes/payments.ts at /v1/payments. Validation comes from offer-core.validateSelection. Data access through the Repo interface. Razorpay test mode.
task.objective: Implement POST /order and POST /verify per razorpay_contract, both modes, signature verification and idempotency, tested with a mocked Razorpay HTTP layer.
task.constraints: Keep export paymentsRoutes(deps: Deps): Hono<AppEnv>. client.ts: fetch-based, Basic auth, 8 s timeout, one retry on 5xx or network error with jittered backoff, never retry 4xx. Refuse to run unless RAZORPAY_KEY_ID starts with rzp_test_. signature.ts: HMAC-SHA256 hex via crypto.subtle, constant-time compare. Malformed signatures return verified false, not 400. order: validateSelection first (repo.getAllOffers, deps.now()); 409 invalid_offer; 409 amount_too_low below RAZORPAY_MIN_AMOUNT_PAISE; choose mode; insert payments row (status created, cartPaise, expectedSavingPaise, mode); return keyId (never the secret). verify: verify signature; mismatch -> mark failed, 200 {verified:false}; match -> mark verified, insert payment_verified event; idempotent on razorpay_payment_id (getPaymentByOrderId). Never log the secret or signatures.
